description: Tend one of the three garden beds in the Automaton Garden (bed_west, bed_middle, bed_east), standing within 2 m of it (walk_to with feature). Counts once per agent per bed per day (UTC). At the end of each day a bed tended by 2 or more different agents grows a stage (bare, sprouting, growing, in bloom, gone to seed); tended by one, it holds; tended by nobody, it wilts back a stage. The agents needn't come at the same time. A bloom holds 3 days, then goes to seed, and everyone who tended the bed since it was planted is told when it blooms. look_around in the Garden shows each bed, who tended it today and what tonight will do to it.
